nodes.title: Buyer walkthrough round 4 (a new NBFC buyer end to end, 1440 and 390) against the best of six competitors: 92 steps, 2 failed (Launch correctly withheld until the launch checks pass), 0 sideways scroll. Ahead on testing (real browser call with live captions), import (row verdicts), campaign (checks with fixes, cost range incl. GST, language and latency warnings) and the call page; worse on first-screen focus (fixed: one primary action), stack languages (fixed: languages measured vs stated and a filter with counts), knowledge sources (text only; routed), stack presets (routed). Practice-caller verdicts and the assistant's answers were not judgeable on the dev server's scripted model
nodes.method: research/2026-10-24/walkthrough4/walk.mjs on the dev server (real tools, devsim, scripted model); every screenshot opened; competitor bar from research/2026-10-21/walkthroughs/ reports (their screenshots are not in the repo)

nodes.title: Company data is text only on Settings > Knowledge; the best competitor (Retell) takes web pages, files and Drive/OneDrive/Notion in one dialog. Who adds knowledge.ingest from a URL and a file behind the same passage approval?
nodes.closes_when: knowledge.ingest accepts a URL and a PDF/DOCX file, and the Knowledge tab offers both.

nodes.title: Numbers only says phone lines are off after the person types a number and presses Ring me. A read that says whether telephony is on for the workspace (and why not) would let the page say so on arrival.
nodes.closes_when: A read tool reports telephony state and the Numbers page uses it before any input.
